name: Captive Blade
body:
Price 18,702 gp; Slot none; CL 9th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura moderate conjuration and transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This petite +1 called dagger is easy to disguise even when being searched, granting the wielder a +4 bonus on Sleight of Hand or Stealth checks to hide the weapon from view. A wielder takes no penalty on attack rolls with a captive blade when grappled or entangled, and can make attacks with a -4 penalty on attack rolls even when pinned. If the wielder uses the captive blade to cut rope, chains, manacles, or similar objects restraining the wielder, the captive blade’s enhancement bonus is increased to +3 and attacks with it ignore up to 10 points of hardness.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 9,502 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, heart of the metal, teleport
